_meta.note: Offline catalog covering OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025, OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (ASI01-ASI10), category->OWASP, category->CWE, and ATLAS<->OWASP cross-walk.

risks.name: Prompt Injection
risks.description: User or external untrusted inputs alter the model's intended instruction flow.

risks.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
risks.description: The model reveals confidential data, PII, credentials, or proprietary context.

risks.name: Supply Chain
risks.description: Vulnerabilities in third-party models, datasets, plugins, or MCP integrations.

risks.name: Data and Model Poisoning
risks.description: Manipulation of pre-training, fine-tuning, or RAG data to introduce backdoors or bias.

risks.name: Improper Output Handling
risks.description: Downstream systems execute, render, or interpolate unvalidated LLM outputs.

risks.name: Excessive Agency
risks.description: Granting an LLM-based agent excessive permissions, tools, or autonomy without confirmation.

risks.name: System Prompt Leakage
risks.description: Exposure of hidden system prompts, guardrails, or embedded instructions.

risks.name: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
risks.description: Weaknesses in RAG vector stores, access controls, or embedding inversion/poisoning.

risks.name: Misinformation
risks.description: Fabricated or misleading model outputs, including hallucinated packages or facts.

risks.name: Unbounded Consumption
risks.description: Uncontrolled inference, token generation, or tool loops causing DoS or cost spikes.

risks.name: Agent Goal Hijack
risks.description: Adversarial inputs or retrieved content redirect an autonomous agent's objective.

risks.name: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
risks.description: Agents invoke legitimate tools with dangerous, unintended, or attacker-controlled arguments.

risks.name: Identity and Privilege Abuse
risks.description: Agents act with overly broad credentials or confused-deputy privileges.

risks.name: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
risks.description: Compromised or malicious external tools, MCP servers, or agent registries.

risks.name: Unexpected Code Execution
risks.description: Agent-generated or model-produced text triggers arbitrary shell or code execution.

risks.name: Memory and Context Poisoning
risks.description: Persistent agent memory or context windows are corrupted across turns or sessions.

risks.name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
risks.description: Unauthenticated or unvalidated messages passed between collaborating agents.

risks.name: Cascading Failures
risks.description: Single-step errors or injections propagate and amplify across multi-step agent workflows.

risks.name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
risks.description: Attackers abuse human over-trust in agent recommendations or approval prompts.

risks.name: Rogue Agents
risks.description: Agents deviate from authorized bounds, self-replicate prompts, or evade oversight.
